observation.command:
TOKEN=$(grep -E 'API_BEARER_TOKEN=' /workspace/web_application/.env.local | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"')
printf 'Full token: %s\n' "$TOKEN"
printf 'Length: %s\n' "${#TOKEN}"
printf 'sha256: %s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$TOKEN" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
printf 'DB hash : %s\n' "$(docker exec vereinfacht-database-1 mariadb -uverein -pverein verein -N -e "SELECT token FROM personal_access_tokens WHERE tokenable_id=1;" 2>/dev/null)"
echo
echo "=== Live re-auth with the .env.local token (decisive) ==="
curl -s --max-time 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/vnd.api+json" "http://localhost:3001/api/v1/users" -o /tmp/reauth.json -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"
head -c 200 /tmp/reauth.json; echo
echo
echo "=== Roles assigned to user 1 ==="
docker exec vereinfacht-database-1 mariadb -uverein -pverein verein -N -e "SELECT r.name FROM roles r JOIN model_has_roles mhr ON mhr.role_id=r.id AND mhr.model_id=1;" 2>&1
